# Desk Basics

Move around the desk and work with lists, views, forms, search and collaboration tools.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Desk](desk.md) | Find your way around the Frappe desk - login, apps screen, dock, sidebar, workspaces, search, notifications, user menu and keyboard shortcuts. |
| [List View](list-view.md) | Find, filter, sort and select documents in the desk list view, run bulk actions, and set list settings and saved layouts. |
| [Views](views.md) | Show the documents of a DocType as a report, kanban board, calendar, gantt chart, tree, dashboard, image grid, map or email inbox. |
| [Form View](form-view.md) | Read and change one document in the desk form - layout, save, submit, cancel and amend, timeline, attachments, sharing, print, email, links, duplicate, rename and form shortcuts. |
| [Search](search.md) | Find pages and documents with the awesomebar, global search, list filters and tags, and control what global search indexes. |
| [Collaboration](collaboration.md) | Work on documents with other users - assignments and ToDo, sharing, comments and mentions, likes, follow, tags, activity and the notification log. |
